记录有去西边旧站的路。那里有修管子的东西。.english: The record has the route to the old station in the west. There is a part there for repairing the pipe.

interlinear.gloss: the route to the western old station
interlinear.pinyin: qù xī biān jiù zhàn de lù 。

interlinear.gloss: a part for repairing the pipe
interlinear.pinyin: xiū guǎn zi de dōng xi 。

我们知道路，不过没有水可以检查。那里的水还不能喝。.pinyin: wǒ men zhī dào lù ， bú guò méi yǒu shuǐ kě yǐ jiǎn chá 。 nà lǐ de shuǐ hái bù néng hē 。
我们知道路，不过没有水可以检查。那里的水还不能喝。.english: We know the route, but have no water to test. Water there still cannot be drunk.

我们知道旧站在西边。不过，要先找安全的路。.pinyin: wǒ men zhī dào jiù zhàn zài xī biān 。 bú guò ， yào xiān zhǎo ān quán de lù 。
我们知道旧站在西边。不过，要先找安全的路。.english: We know the old station is in the west. But we must first find a safe route.

we must first find a safe route

记录说旧站本来关了。为什么还会有水来？.pinyin: jì lù shuō jiù zhàn běn lái guān le 。 wèi shén me hái huì yǒu shuǐ lái ？
记录说旧站本来关了。为什么还会有水来？.english: The record says the old station was closed. Why is water still coming from it?

interlinear.pinyin: jiù zhàn běn lái guān le 。

不知道。我们一起去研究吧。.pinyin: bù zhī dào 。 wǒ men yì qǐ qù yán jiū ba 。
不知道。我们一起去研究吧。.english: I do not know. Let us investigate together.

我等她先记录。然后补充我说的话。.pinyin: wǒ děng tā xiān jì lù 。 rán hòu bǔ chōng wǒ shuō de huà 。
我等她先记录。然后补充我说的话。.english: I wait for her to make the record first. Then I add my account.

风起来了。先选一个办法，然后我就过去。.english: The wind is rising. Choose one approach first; then I will cross.
